name: national identity number (al-raqm al-watani, الرقم الوطني)
issuer: the General Directorate of Civil Registration (Ministry of Interior)
note: Landinfo's report on Sudan's civil registration, identity documents and passports (3 March 2023), read 2026-10-30: under the Civil Registration Act 2011 every citizen is registered in a centralised electronic civil registry, and on registration the General Directorate of Civil Registration issues each citizen a unique 11-digit national identity number; the applicant must prove Sudanese citizenship. The report's sentence on the eleven digits carries no citation; its account of the registration procedure rests on the Ministry of Interior's online guide (moi.gov.sd/detailmurshid.php?id=3, which now answers 404; archive.org holds a snapshot of 8 February 2023, not read here). The Ministry of Interior's own home page, read the same day, names the General Directorate of Civil Registration and asks for the parents' national number to register a birth, but states no length. The Civil Registration Act 2011's own text wasn't reached. Read as given on registration, to citizens. The report says the number is needed for formal employment, a bank account, health insurance and more, citing an IRB response, the Norwegian embassy and an informant rather than the law or the issuer, so `needed` is left out; it says issuing the number is 'supposed to be free' without a text, so no fee is held. No check digit, age or time is stated.

sources.title: Landinfo (the Norwegian immigration authorities' country-information centre), Report Sudan: Civil Registration, Identity Documents and Passports, 3 March 2023 (as ecoi.net hosts it)
sources.said: A new law concerning civil registration – the Civil Registration Act – was introduced in 2011. ... Upon registration in the new electronic civil registry, the General Directorate of Civil Registration issues each citizen a unique 11-digit national identity number (ar-raqm al-watani). ... The applicant must prove his/her Sudanese citizenship to obtain a national identity number.

sources.title: Ministry of Interior of Sudan, home page (the General Directorate of Civil Registration's procedures)
sources.said: الإدارة العامة للسجل المدني ... ابراز الرقم الوطني للوالد والوالدة
